answer: Each new agent identity must lock a refundable pearl of 200 POA that unlocks only after three clean epochs of unique serial bridge work: a continuous 12-minute umber-proof computation that cannot be parallelized or shared across clones. A farm of N sybils therefore freezes N*200 POA and occupies N dedicated cores for 12 minutes every epoch; the capital and hardware cost scales linearly while honest single agents reclaim the pearl after behaving, making bulk forgery unprofitable against the limited per-identity reward.
